payload.title: File:Devonian lungfish skulls (ventral view).jpg
payload.credit_html: "A new Devonian lungfish from the western Karakoram of northern Pakistan"
payload.description_html: Comparison of some Devonian lungfish skulls in ventral view. (A) Holodipterus gogoensis (after Miles, 1977). (B) Chirodipterus australis (after Miles, 1977). (C) Dipterus valenciennesi (after White, 1965). (D) Talentichthys kuragh. Not to scale.
